readings.summary: Fix the crashes by making location lookups null-safe (FirstOrDefault/Location.None) for metadata symbols so the generator and analyzer complete without throwing and a resolver is generated, with the closed generic struct still processed as before.

readings.summary: Avoid the crash by not running GetObjectInfo (and its diagnostics) on closed generic types from referenced assemblies, treating them as externally provided, so no formatter is generated for them in the consuming assembly.
readings.code_difference: Adds a check in CollectGeneric to skip or short-circuit for metadata symbols instead of fixing the location lookups, so no formatter or diagnostics are produced for Item<int>.
